teaser.en: In Diani, the most common Digo way to keep mosquitoes off is to burn the leaves of this fragrant bush.
teaser.sw: Huko Diani, njia ya kawaida zaidi kwa Wadigo kufukuza mbu ni kuchoma majani ya kichaka hiki chenye harufu nzuri.

summary.en: *Chivumbani* is tree basil, an aromatic shrubby herb of bushland and fallow. Its leaves are burned to drive away mosquitoes and used in medicine and spiritual healing.
summary.sw: *Chivumbani* ni kivumbani, mmea wenye harufu nzuri kama kichaka unaoota vichakani na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike. Majani yake huchomwa kufukuza mbu, na hutumika kama dawa na katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

about.en: *Chivumbani* is an aromatic, shrubby herb with soft, hairy leaves and the square stems of the mint family. Crushed leaves give off a strong, pleasant smell. Small pale flowers grow in spikes at the tips of the stems.
about.sw: *Chivumbani* ni mmea wenye harufu nzuri kama kichaka, wenye majani laini yenye vinyweleo na mashina ya pembe nne ya familia ya minanaa. Majani yaliyopondwa hutoa harufu kali na nzuri. Maua madogo ya rangi hafifu huota kwenye vishada kwenye ncha za mashina.

where.en: It grows in bushland and on fallow land.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike.

uses.en:
The leaves are burned to repel mosquitoes. Among the Digo of Diani this is the most common way of keeping them off, reported by more than half of the people asked in one survey.

The leaves are also boiled as a remedy for malaria, inhaled for colds, and used in spiritual healing.
uses.sw:
Majani yake huchomwa kufukuza mbu. Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa Diani hii ndiyo njia ya kawaida zaidi ya kuwaepusha, kama walivyoripoti zaidi ya nusu ya watu waliohojiwa katika utafiti mmoja.

Majani hayo pia huchemshwa kutibu malaria, mvuke wake huvutwa kwa mafua, na hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

names.en: The Digo name is *chivumbani*. Swahili calls it *kivumbani*. In English it is tree basil.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *chivumbani*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *kivumbani*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *tree basil*.

reason.en: Same genus; African basil, also used in spiritual healing
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; mrihani, pia hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho

reason.en: Another aromatic member of the mint family
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye harufu nzuri wa familia ya minanaa

reason.en: Another plant used against malaria and insects
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotumika dhidi ya malaria na wadudu
Mmea mwingine wa dawa wenye harufu nzuri
